_note: Use case library for retail / e-commerce engagements. Canonical standard: OAGIS 10.x. Created 2026-05-19 during Homage engagement (Vera step 4).

usecases.useCase: E-commerce ↔ ERP full integration: orders, inventory, fulfillments, products, customers, returns, billing
usecases.whatWasBuilt: End-to-end Shopify ↔ NetSuite integration covering order intake, inventory sync, fulfillment writeback, product catalog management (including metafields), customer sync, and billing reconciliation.
usecases.outcome: 30% reduction in operating expenses; month-end close to 5 days; 2 admin FTE eliminated
usecases.aiLayer: AI agent monitors inventory velocity → flags stockout risk → surfaces reorder recommendation with lead-time context

usecases.useCase: AI-driven inventory redistribution and markdown prevention across retail channels
usecases.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft API-led integration connecting commerce, ERP, and CRM with experience APIs for AI agents — autonomous inventory monitoring, anomaly detection, and fulfillment triggering.
usecases.outcome: Inventory redistribution 7-10 days → under 1 hour; markdown losses $5.4M → $1.6M/quarter; sell-through revenue +23%
usecases.aiLayer: Autonomous AI agents monitor inventory levels → detect redistribution opportunities → trigger moves and alert merchandising team within 1 hour of signal detection

usecases.useCase: Order intake: Shopify orders → NetSuite (cash sales or sales orders with routing logic)
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Webhook-triggered MuleSoft flow ingesting Shopify orders and routing to NetSuite as cash sale or sales order based on classification logic. Handles real-time event and retry/idempotency.

clients.projectContext: iPaaS migration from Celigo — 23 Shopify ↔ NetSuite flows

usecases.useCase: Inventory sync with CSWOS (Continue Selling While Out of Stock) tiered delivery logic
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Scheduled MuleSoft flow syncing NetSuite inventory levels to Shopify, including cross-reference between Shopify variant IDs and NetSuite item IDs, and enforcing CSWOS tiered thresholds per SKU.

clients.projectContext: iPaaS migration from Celigo — complex CSWOS business logic

usecases.useCase: Product sync: NetSuite matrix items → Shopify products with metafield management, price, and tax sync
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Scheduled MuleSoft flow mapping NetSuite matrix item (parent/child variant) structure to Shopify product/variant model, including metafield population and price/tax sync.

clients.projectContext: iPaaS migration — complex NetSuite matrix item → Shopify variant mapping with metafields

usecases.useCase: Internal NetSuite transformation: sales order → invoice
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Event-triggered MuleSoft flow executing an internal NetSuite-to-NetSuite transformation, converting sales orders to invoices without leaving the ERP.

clients.projectContext: iPaaS migration — internal NetSuite workflow automation
